provider: Tencent Cloud Agent Runtime  -  Agent Sandbox

free_tier.stated: CPU bills at CNY 0.000081 a core-second, charged from a successful start to a stop; a paused instance stops CPU and memory billing and pays only the storage its state needs; the system disk has a 15 GiB free allowance while an instance runs, but no free allowance while it is paused

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: the rootfs system disk is released automatically when the instance is destroyed and its data is then unrecoverable; no fixed retention period is stated
retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
